machine_end_gcode:
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 E-1.2 Z{max_layer_z + 0.5} F1800 ;Retract and raise Z
{if max_layer_z < 50}
G1 Z{max_layer_z + 25} F900 ;Raise Z more
{endif}

SMART_PARK ;Park head at front for easy removal
M106 S0 ;Turn-off fan
M104 S0 ;Turn-off hotend
M140 S0 ;Turn-off bed
M84 X Y E ;Disable all steppers but Z
machine_start_gcode:
M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate
SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT ACCEL_TO_DECEL=2500 ;revert accel_to_decel back to 2500
SET_INPUT_SHAPER SHAPER_FREQ_X=58.0 SHAPER_FREQ_Y=58.0 ;input shaper to reduce ringing
SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT SQUARE_CORNER_VELOCITY=5 ;sharper corners
SET_RETRACTION RETRACT_LENGTH=1.0 RETRACT_SPEED=30 UNRETRACT_EXTRA_LENGTH=0 ;firmware retraction
RESPOND MSG=Power loss recovery enabled

M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;Set bed temp (don't wait)
G28 ;Home all axes
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z up for safe travel
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ;Auto level (nozzle cold = no ooze, clears brush area)

M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Set nozzle temp (don't wait)
G1 X1 Y-18 Z3 F5000.0 ;Line up with brush (preheat while moving)
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] ;Wait for bed temp
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] ;Wait for nozzle temp

;-- Nozzle wipe (Z1.5 adjusted to not hit brush mount) --
G1 X87 Y-16 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 1
G1 X46 Y-16 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 2
G1 X87 Y-16 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 3
G1 X46 Y-16 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 4
G1 X87 Y-19 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 5
G1 X46 Y-19 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 6
G1 X87 Y-19 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 7
G1 X46 Y-19 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 8
G1 X87 Y-19 Z1.5 F5000.0 ;Wipe 9 (end away from brush to avoid re-pickup)
G1 X40 Y-18 Z15 F5000.0 ;Raise to clear brush

;-- Purge lines --
G1 X-2.0 Y20 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move to purge start
G1 X-2.0 Y145.0 Z0.28 F1500.0 E15 ;Draw first purge line
G1 X-1.7 Y145.0 Z0.28 F5000.0 ;Move side
G1 X-1.7 Y20 Z0.28 F1500.0 E30 ;Draw second purge line
G92 E0 ;Reset Extruder
G1 E-1.0000 F1800 ;Retract
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ;Move Z up
G1 E0.0000 F1800 ;Recover
